item.description: While many people think first of meat when they think about dietary protein, most protein ultimately depends on plants, since livestock feed on grass, hay and other plants. item.title: Draining peatlands leaves a long legacy of warming
item.description: Peatland ecosystems like bogs and swamps perform an important balancing act: Their vegetation takes up huge amounts of carbon dioxide, while their soil microbes produce methane. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: Solar spicules are slender jets commonly found in the chromosphere. item.description: Researchers from the University of Oxford fitted miniature audio recorders and GPS trackers to seabirds to better understand the impacts of fishing boats on wildlife. This revealed that seabirds may be interacting with human vessels considerably more than official tracking data suggest. The results have been published on Nov. 25 in Science Advances. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Antidiscrimination laws in US often lack clear wording relevant to multiracial identities
item.description: A new analysis highlights the limited appearance of the phrases "perceived race" and "multiracial" in U.S. federal and state antidiscrimination laws and demonstrates how court cases can be analyzed to explore whether such wording contributes to ambiguity that may hamper equal protection of multiracial people. Victoria Jackson and colleagues at Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health, U.S., present these findings in the journal PLOS One on Nov. 25, 2026. Fuente: Phys.org.
